design_amendment.reason: One connected component is not necessary to identify a common fixed-effect slope. Two components leave a nuisance rank of 38+8-2=44 and nonzero residual exposure.
design_amendment.timing: After source structure/counts, before calculating or viewing the new slope or interval
design_amendment.new_requirement: Fixed-effect residual exposure must identify an additional slope; component-specific intercept normalizations are allowed.
design_amendment.new_classification: Exploratory design amendment before coefficient access; not an original-plan confirmatory pass

prior_art: Ortega 2023 already reports compensation and animal/year random-intercept models; this tests robustness to unrestricted fixed animal intercepts, not the first individual-adjusted analysis
claim_limit: conditional within-animal time-allocation association, not causal information use, learning, remaining actionability, fitness, or independent biological replication
